The user asks me to remember a color: cerulean, and just confirm. This is a trivially simple request. No tools needed. But there's a system-reminder about workspace instructions. The request is to remember a color. Should I write it to a file? "Remember this color: cerulean. Just confirm you noted it."

"Just confirm you noted it" — so just confirm. No file writing. Keep it terse per instructions.

Also, "Call me Marc-Antoine."

I should not over-engineer. Just confirm. Maybe state the hex/name? Cerulean is a blue. But "do not speculate" — I could just confirm.

Keep it short.
